card.name: Linking words in Jesus and Muhammad creed statements
card.fires_on: Small linking words (is, that, the, as, of, awaited) inside religious declarations about Jesus as Messiah/Christ or Muhammad as prophet/messenger. The word comes just before a religious title or claim.

modes.label: Muhammad creed
modes.description: Linking word inside the Islamic statement of faith, before 'messenger' or 'prophet'.
modes.example: (I Swear That There Is No God But Allah And Mohammad<< Is>> His Messenger)

modes.label: Jesus as Messiah or Christ
modes.description: Linking word in claims that Jesus was the Messiah or Christ, just before the title.
modes.example: that he was<< the>> Christ of God, with his resurrection becoming

card.writes: It pushes the model toward religious words such as Jesus, faith, believers and religion.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in sentences declaring that Jesus is the Messiah or Muhammad is God's messenger.
